'''Freedom Station''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rueb]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. It was located near an important [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] travel route but was disabled for several months after a battle.
